editorial.name: Buy Me a Coffee
editorial.descriptionZh: Buy Me a Coffee 让创作者收粉丝打赏、开会员订阅、上架商品，也能直接发帖、音频和邮件。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看打赏、会员、商店三块怎么串成一条动线
editorial.noteZh: 顶栏是 FAQ、Wall of ♡、Resources、Search creators 搜索框、Log in 与黄色 Sign up，首屏一行绿星写着 Loved by 2,000,000+ creators，大字 Fund your creative work，副题 Accept support. Start a membership. Setup a shop. It's easier than you think.，黄色按钮 Start my page 下面一句 It's free and takes less than a minute!；左边飘着一张创作者卡，写着 Teacher Stefano is creating YouTube videos and Podcast 与 ♡ 703 supporters。往下三段各有样机：SUPPORT 是一个打赏组件，Buy Juliet a coffee ☕ 配 1/3/5 金额与 Say something nice...，动态条里滚着 Anie bought 10 coffees、Cathy G bought a coffee. Thanks Cathy!；MEMBERSHIPS 列 Pro membership $15/month、Basic membership $5/month、Advanced membership $25/month；SHOP 段写 Introducing Shop, the creative way to sell.。
editorial.pricing: Free（首页写 Start my page. It's free and takes less than a minute!）

reasons.statement: 交付物是创作者在自己页面上收打赏、卖会员与商品的一套托管服务（Start my page 注册即可），不是可拿走的模板或素材，归产品与公司官网。
拿不准：站内有 Search creators 的创作者检索和 /reviews 页，带一点目录与社区性质；但首页主体是三段产品介绍，仍按产品官网归档。
